comparison.objective: Identify and move only desk cups that are not stuck; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle probing of hidden attachment state and selective transport versus two-tool torque adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both loose cups in tray without moving the stuck cup versus locked opening and repeatable function.
comparison.reason: Force-probing and selective clearing are unrelated to jam-nut locking.
